programs.description: Four candidates competing in the sarpanch election go through a series of hilarious situations as they try to lure villagers into voting for them.
When the employees of an organisation desperately attempt to impress their newly appointed boss, it leads to the creation of several misunderstandings and confusion.
Bringing the best in cinema.
A 13-year-old boy named Toti forms a bond with a man named Amli. Later, after discovering Amli's struggle with drug addiction, Toti tries to gather money for his rehabilitation.
A wealthy man who feels a void in his life due to a lack of family and love. To rediscover his roots, he returns to his ancestral village, only to discover a community consumed by mobile phones.
A young boy aims to be a professional singer, and wishes to go to the city of dreams, Mumbai, to fulfill his dream. Meanwhile, his financial state doesn't allow him to move there.
Vikramjit has an addictive habit of playing on the phone extensively and due to this habit, one day both his wife and son leave him.
Bringing the best in movies.
Sisters, Mansi and Bansi, face a setback in their relationship when Mansi becomes a popular singer and gets Bansi married to an ill-suited man.
Bhinder returns to his hometown from America to meet his father. However, his father does not welcome him as he went abroad against his wishes.
A group of men who have landed themselves in jail decide to try their luck and make an elaborate plan to escape from prison.
Karan's girlfriend challenges him to woo any woman and make her marry him. He chooses a woman named Saryu, only to find out that she has an overprotective brother.
A newly married couple finds it difficult to accept each other's personalities and decide to legally separate. However, during their divorce party, a series of unexpected events take place.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Ujjagar Singh, a widower with three children, is admitted to the hospital and learns that his sons are praying for his death from the Grim Reaper.

Harman falls in love with Lali, who works as a prostitute at a brothel. Soon, the two get married, but their life changes when Lali gets kidnapped by goons.
